meaning.long_meaning: Baji corresponds to the Marathi form बाजी. Its core lexical sense is wager, bet; stake. बाजी (baji) means a wager or stake, and is also a Marathi honorific. The source record asserted no usable gloss; the lexical sense is recorded here but the name usage is not independently verified.
